games.name: a long hike [Alpha]
games.desc:
Hike with your friends, camp and survive each mile against violent storms, challenges, and enemies.

In 1987, a research team tested a signal known as The Echo Tone, meant to guide wildlife north.
But the sound changed them instead — especially the raccoons. The forest went silent, and the team vanished along a twelve-mile trail. Decades later, the route has reopened. Something still walks it.

Gather your friends and hike twelve miles through shifting forests and violent storms. Build, cook, and survive the nights… but when darkness falls, the hunt begins.
